verbatim_quote.original: Code Reviewer: audit task 272 in tasks/qa/ against its Goal, Acceptance Criteria, and Verification Evidence. Judge ONLY the attached Factual Git Diff hunks plus the task file content — check that every AC/DoD box honestly checked is supported by recorded evidence, flag any stale claims (e.g. version numbers superseded by later rounds), and return verdict APPROVED or APPROVED_WITH_CHANGES or REJECTED_NEEDS_FIXES with file+line citations.

extracted_decision.summary: Ordered Code Reviewer to audit task 272 strictly against goal, acceptance criteria, and verification evidence using only attached diff and task file, verify every checked AC/DoD box, flag stale claims, and return one of three verdicts with file+line citations.
extracted_decision.rationale: Ensure evidence-based review and prevent closure of tasks with unsupported or stale claims.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Limits reviewer to attached artifacts, may miss live state; Strict evidence gate can delay approval; Reduces hallucination and improves auditability
